capabilities: Answer questions with cited sources from vault notes
Search notes by meaning with hybrid keyword and semantic search
Run editable AI skill prompt templates stored as notes
Generate daily reviews with spaced repetition and weekly reports
Organize notes with health checks and AI suggestions before applying changes
disambiguation: Not a note-writing tool; it works over your existing vault with AI Q&A, search, review and organization suggestions.
extras: Freemium: all plugin features are free without an account, but some skill packs in the built-in skill market require a paid EduAIoT membership. The README is bilingual (English and Chinese) and includes a detailed network-use and privacy section.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to question your vault with verifiable citations, find notes by meaning, or get automated review, reporting and cleanup suggestions.

relations.evidence: when the desktop app is running, the plugin can use its model and its shared search index
an API key from a model provider you choose, or a local model via Ollama

requires.name: EduAIoT desktop app (optional, shares model and search index)

summary: AI assistant that answers questions from your notes with cited sources, semantic search, daily review, weekly reports, topic maps and vault organization.
